title: It’s a fraudulent app subscription wise

Also disadvise to subscribe through their website, not sure if I did it, I certainly didn’t mean to. But I didn’t see any information about it in my App store account, so I couldn’t really know about this subscription, and this way I didn’t get any notification that I would be charged soon((( very unpleasant experience(

author: MrMrRobat

title: Greedy and lazy business owners spoil amazing concept
body:
You still show “free 7 days” and then take 40 bucks instead. Isn’t it convenient for you?
This app is so expensive, and there is so little necessary functionality. I don’t want to get bloody “circle coach” PUSH notifications. I want to build habits and get inspired. Get your coach somewhere deeper in the app - it is not convenient to have it at the most prominent tab. If I want it - I get. I don’t appreciate those coach things being pushed into my face. Also, for many years now you haven’t build a proper synchronisation of data to an account. To much disappointment from one application.
author: desormais.marguerite

title: REFUND URGENTLY
body: Dear Fabulous Team, I joined the app and had a 7 day free trial offer appear to me, therefore I proceeded with entering my payment details. I got charged for a 1 year trial, although as I mentioned before I had a 7 day free trial offer. This is absolutely unacceptable and unfair. I wanted to join your app to better my life and furthermore if I enjoyed using it for a week to prolong my subscription, but this experience has been disappointing so far and it really broke my trust. I need my money refunded to me as soon as possible, it was my last money. Your app is about health, but such inconveniences only bring stress!!!!!!!!
